level: Cultivation Technician I / entry occupational pathway
intendedAudience: Learners progressing through the THC Cultivation Technician I pathway
Entry-level cultivation employees developing supervised operational competency
evidencePolicy: Use canonical evidence-backed science and operational references for durable principles. Facility SOPs, product labels, equipment manuals, and jurisdiction-specific requirements control when they are more specific. Reused curriculum modules are development dependencies and do not substitute for course-specific occupational review.
assessmentPolicy: This draft course is not credential evidence merely because its structure exists. Course-specific formative work, a course-level summative assessment, accessibility review, human technical review, and any required practical evidence must be completed and validated before the course can advance beyond draft/review status.
title: Harvest, Postharvest, Traceability & Shift Handoff
description: Prepares Technician I learners to execute authorized harvest and postharvest handoffs while protecting sanitation, plant/material identity, lot genealogy, movement records, counts/weights, discrepancy reporting, and communication to the receiving shift or role.
learningOutcomes: Verify harvest authorization, batch identity, destination, PPE, pathways, tools and sanitation readiness and stop/escalate changed unsafe conditions.
Execute authorized harvest and dry-room receiving while protecting material condition, contamination control, lot separation and monitored postharvest process context.
Preserve source-to-output genealogy and reconcile counts, weights, movements, holds and receiving status without forcing physical and digital records to match falsely.
Produce a reconstructable harvest/postharvest handoff that distinguishes normal receiving, partial completion, holds, deviations, unresolved conditions and required follow-up.
